statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-33815 is in pgproto3 Backend.Receive / Bind.Decode, which handles messages received by a PostgreSQL server. openfga uses pgx/v5 exclusively as a client connecting to PostgreSQL; it never instantiates a pgproto3.Backend or accepts PostgreSQL wire-protocol connections. The vulnerable server-side decode path is never executed.

caddy is built with the nopgx build tag, which excludes all pgx-related code at compile time. The pgx/v5 module appears in the SBOM as a transitive dependency but its code is not linked into the binary. The vulnerable pgproto3 Backend.Receive / Bind.Decode server-side path cannot be reached.
